name: the-first-perception
description: Studio-grade solo text-based living-world RPG. Hosted on Kimi.

scripts.build: npm run content:compile && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.build:packages: npm --prefix packages/types run build && npm --prefix packages/engine run build && npm --prefix packages/persistence run build && npm --prefix packages/llm-client run build && npm --prefix packages/narrative run build && npm --prefix packages/audio run build && npm --prefix packages/ui-system run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/persistence run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/engine run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck && tsc -p api/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm --prefix packages/persistence test && npm --prefix packages/engine test && npm --prefix apps/web test
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
scripts.clean: rm -rf apps/web/dist packages/engine/dist && npm --prefix packages/engine run clean
